review_candidates.title: Instructional Designer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Design end-to-end programs and learning journeys - from learning objectives and content sequencing to practice, assessment, and reinforcement. At least 2 years of experience in instructional design and eLearning creation.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Skills, Knowledge & Expertise Excellent written English and Arabic, with strong editing, formatting, and content structuring skills. At least 2 years of experience in instructional design and eLearning creation. Hands-on experience with learning and design tools such as Figma, Canva, Articulate Rise/Storyline, Google Slides, and LMS platforms. Hands-on experience using AI models and digital tools to automate and scale L&D work, including quizzes, assessments, content creation, and other learning workflows. Experience collaborating with training, QA, compliance, or product teams Experience supporting multilingual teams or agents with limited English proficiency is a plus.
